Those rows carry used 3 times here, used 20 times here, and used once here, and Recent here says everything used here is suggested above. Search for pull keeps that query, shows Results · 3, and keeps used 20 times here. With history off, Suggested here starts Run check then Run fmt, Recent here says nothing used here yet, and the same search keeps pull with Results · 3 and the row reason up to date, without used 20 times here. The settled pull search is captured at 120×40 and then at 80×24 before the terminal returns to 120×40. Learned queries do not draw: ranking drops a word miss before the remembered boost, so neither pull for git.fetch nor Ünï  Code for cargo.clippy appears. The 25-use git.pull seed draws as used 20 times here.

The parity-history PTY never shows a malformed frecency.json or a save failure.
